name: Allow bulk read on a non-ARN, non-star Resource (suffix key glob '*.pem')
note: S1-breadth-failclosed regression. A Resource value that is neither '*' nor arn:-shaped ('*.pem') is MALFORMED per the AWS IAM grammar (a Resource element must be '*' or an ARN). validate.js does no ARN-shape validation, so the value reaches the rules engine, whose semantic probe battery can only PROVE a value broad (>=2 probe accounts) and never NARROW; '*.pem' matches zero fixed-key probes, so it was read as NARROW and a bulk s3:GetObject returned findings=[] status complete exit 0 CLEAN - a DATA-EXFIL fail-OPEN (threat-model T8). The shared engine now routes the undecidable value to coverage.incomplete (MALFORMED_RESOURCE_ARN) so neither the browser nor the CLI reports a clean pass. It is a masked grant, not a fabricated confident finding, because the exact scope is genuinely undecidable.
